verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a REST API and a GitHub repository of Bash and PHP code examples, with no OpenAPI spec found. Example scripts and a raw REST API are developer building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story. missing for 10: any official, maintained client SDK in any language, SDK documentation, package-registry distribution, and independent corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
